name: cqf-skills
title: CQF Skills (knowledge graph)
description: The cqframework Agent Skills for CQL, FHIR, FHIR Clinical Reasoning and FHIR content IGs, forked and laid out as a cat-harness knowledge graph: each skill a node in its plugin's package, the processes that use them as BPMN, and the roles that play their lanes. Upstream's layout stays the source.

assets.title: The knowledge-graph layer
assets.description: What the fork adds, what is generated and by which command, and how a skill moves upstream.

directories.description: One package per plugin of .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (cql, fhir, clinical-reasoning, fhir-ig), each a package-manifest.json and one node per skill, generated by tools/kg-index/kg_index.py from skills/<name>/SKILL.md. The skills themselves, with their resources, scripts and evals, stay in skills/ and evals/ in upstream's Agent Skills layout.

BPMN in the content concern group: authoring a CQL library, developing a quality measure, turning a WHO SMART DAK into L3 content, building and publishing a content IG, and adding or changing a skill. Lanes are roles from scenarios/roles.json; tasks name skills.
The roles that play a lane in the processes (knowledge engineer, measure developer, IG author, skill maintainer, cqframework maintainer), each with the skills its tasks need.
Owner directives: what the fork is and keeps from upstream, the bar a fork skill meets before it is offered upstream, and that the beans stay on main.

Open issues of the fork, one bean each under beans/defs/, kept on main (memory/dir-beans-on-main.md): draft skills to check by running, skills still missing, and the harness checks still red in the pinned layers.
kg-index: derives harness/skills/ from skills/*/SKILL.md and marketplace.json (--check in CI).
